thread:
tess_sales: Hey team — AcmeCorp legal just asked for SOC 2 report, ISO summary, and a signed penetration test attestation for the POC. They want evidence delivery via SFTP. POC kickoff is 2026-04-12. Can someone confirm what we can hand over and whether this changes dedicated pricing?

alex_sre: We can provide SOC2 package (redacted) + ISO artifact summary. For the pen-test attestation we need a signed vendor attestation (we don't release raw vuln reports). SFTP is fine but we usually prefer expiring presigned links to avoid long-lived credentials. :thumbsup:

maria_pm: Pricing note — sharing artifacts alone doesn't change pricing. If they need a dedicated/reserved capacity for the POC window or an on-prem staging export, that will. Also if legal requires additional retention or support SLA, that affects the quote.

jordan_sales: @tess_sales can you confirm whether AcmeCorp asked for full logs or just controls evidence? They mentioned "evidence" which is vague — we should clarify now to avoid scope creep.

alex_sre: They asked for "evidence + pen-test attestation" in the email. Recommend we provide: 1) SOC2 report PDF (redacted) 2) ISO 27001 scope and statement of applicability extract 3) Pen-test attestation letter (signed, template, no raw report) 4) Network diagram (sanitized). We should NOT provide raw logs or vuln scan exports.

alex_sre: SFTP workflow: we can provision a short-lived SFTP account or provide an S3 presigned URL bundle. Example we usually send: ```
https://presigned-storage.redwood.example/acme-poc-evidence.zip?expires=2026-04-21T18:00Z
```

sec-bot: PenTest attestation template v2.1 uploaded to /shared/security/pen-attestation-v2.1.docx — please attach signed copy once vendor signs. :white_check_mark:

maria_pm: If legal insists on signed attestation from our testing vendor, ops needs to coordinate signature turnaround. That could add ~3 business days. Flag for the customer.

jordan_sales: I'll ask AcmeCorp to confirm they only need the attestation + controls artifacts and not raw logs. Also asking whether their procurement requires a notarized signature or couriered hard copy.

alex_sre: I'll own the artifact bundle and generate the presigned link once we have the final list and any required redactions. I'll also prepare a redaction checklist (PII, customer data, ephemeral creds).

maria_pm: @tess_sales can you loop in procurement/legal on their specific delivery format and any evidence retention/POC duration that might affect pricing?

tess_sales: Thanks all — I'll ping their legal now and update thread. Assigning ownership: @alex_sre on artifacts & link, @maria_pm on pricing impact, @jordan_sales on legal clarification. Back in a couple hours with reply. :rocket:
